rule: Phase 1, per scenario and level: B_set = the highest mean F1 on that window set among the scenario's baselines (no_finetune: l1, snip, l1_recon; finetune: l1, l1_kd, snip_kd, l1_kdaug at both r). Eligible configuration: mean F1_normal >= B_normal - 1 pt and mean F1_older_like >= B_older_like - 1 pt. Selected = the eligible configuration with the highest mean FA-LCI_val (mean over folds 0, 1 and seeds of each run's min(LCI_normal, LCI_older_like)); ties within 0.005 -> smaller beta, then smaller r. None eligible -> no configuration at that level (flagged, no fallback), and phase 2 skips it.
disclosure: The round-3 design was informed by the Step 9A test-set analysis (posture-class drift: without fine-tuning, older adults' LCI fell more in standing at 70%, sitting at 90% and lying at 50%; the accuracy gap widens at 90%). All round-3 tuning and selection use HARTH inner-validation windows of folds 0 and 1 and their older-like copies only; HAR70+ and the folds' test subjects are never loaded.
